content:
Dear all,

we will be hosting the workshop "Polyhedra in Lean", which will take place August 24 - September 4, 2026 at Freie Universität Berlin. This two-week hands-on workshop will bring together experts on Lean and formalization, experts on the various aspects of polyhedral geometry and combinatorics, and researchers interested in or curious about these topics. Participants will have the opportunity to learn about the process of formalization and contribution to mathlib and get in touch with the Lean community, all within the scope of an active research topic. A major goal will be to plan the formalization of the various aspects of polyhedral theory in the Lean language and to accelerate the integration into mathlib, aiming for a long term collaboration.

You may find further details on the webpage: https://mathconf.eu/pil-fub-2026/

Please register by July 16, 2026; capacities are limited.
Limited travel funds are available for junior researchers. Please send us a short motivation letter (max 1 page) and the name and email address of one reference we may contact. The deadline is July 1, 2026.

Best regards,
Georg Loho (FU Berlin)
Olivia Röhrig (Zuse Institute Berlin)
Martin Winter (MPI-MiS Leipzig)
